name: musica
tagline: Surfaces DJ mixes and long festival recordings to fit your taste, for work or a party
description: A discovery scout for people who would rather have a full set than a shuffled playlist. Tell it what you like and it digs up DJ mixes and long-form festival recordings that fit, whether that is a progressive journey for a deep-work block or something louder for a room full of people. Links point back to YouTube.
author: _wrbr
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
